description: The auxiliary-name occurrence test agrees with membership in the free-name support of the corresponding shared formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.occursAux_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (S : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.EffectiveSignature L) {n : ℕ} (a : L.BoundedFormula ℕ n) (j : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.occursAux j (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.namedCode S a) =
      true ↔
    j ∈ a.freeVarFinset
